title: What's New: Financial Management - Consolidation Improvements (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Consolidation status list and setup demonstration
Currency exchange rate configuration and consolidation run
Results review and recovery scenario introduction
Balance sheet revaluation and mistake recovery process
Selecting and reusing previous exchange rates

features.name: Consolidation status list
features.description: A list showing the history of consolidation runs that have already been performed, allowing users to see which periods and companies were consolidated and any errors that occurred.

features.name: Exchange rate lookup and modification during consolidation
features.description: Users can look up and modify currency exchange rates while in the process of executing consolidation, allowing them to adjust rates to fit the current consolidation process.

features.name: Last closing rate lookup
features.description: Users can look up the last closing rate from previous consolidation runs while performing consolidation, which helps with recovery and revaluation of balance sheet items.

features.name: Consolidation validation
features.description: Validation checks have been introduced to prevent users from accidentally making mistakes during consolidation, such as running consolidation for a period that has already been consolidated.

features.name: Previous consolidation exchange rate selection
features.description: When recovering from mistakes, users can select and reuse the exact exchange rates that were used in previous consolidation runs, either all of them or selectively.
caveats: Requires knowing which previous run to select from; only shows exchange rates actually used in that period

features.name: Closing and average currency factors configuration
features.description: Users can configure different currency factors during consolidation - closing currency factor for balance sheet items and average currency factor for income statement items.
caveats: Last closing currency factor is automatically set by the last run
